speaker_role: independent counselor (Christina Chong, founder of Renaissance Admissions Consulting, citing tips from an unnamed 'former admissions officer')
commercial_incentive: yes; runs a paid boutique admissions consulting firm and invites viewers to contact the business at the end
key_insights: Common App Honors list allows up to 5 entries at 100 characters each; Activities list allows up to 10 entries (50 chars for position, 100 for organization, 150 to describe the activity)
Notable schools not on the Common App include MIT, the UC system, Cal State system, Georgetown, and the U.S. service academies (e.g., West Point)
Advises using action verbs (organized, mobilized, initiated) instead of vague phrasing like 'had meetings,' and quantifying impact with concrete numbers
Recommends placing the strongest activities first and last in the list, with weaker ones in the middle, since reviewers weight the start/end most
Advises against repeating the same honor/award in both the honors and activities lists unless adding genuinely new information
Recommends showing a consistent thematic thread across several activities so a reader can identify a genuinely developed interest, without requiring every activity to relate
The Common App's Additional Information section (up to 650 words) can serve as overflow space for extra honors/activities that don't fit the structured lists
specific_numbers_or_facts: Honors list: up to 5 entries, 100 characters each
Activities list: up to 10 entries; 50 chars for position, 100 for organization, 150 to describe
Additional Information section: up to 650 words
notable_or_distinctive: gives precise character-count limits and concrete formatting tactics (front/back-loading strongest activities, avoiding repetition between lists) more specifically than most similar videos
reliability_notes: the 'former admissions officer' tip source is asserted but not named or verified; character-limit figures should be double-checked against the current Common App platform since these details can change year to year
